mode: read-only real app request failure and recovery in the existing owned 38181 browser session
fault_method: Use agent-browser CDP request interception with failRequest/--abort for the exact same-origin GET endpoint only. Do not return mock success data; do not alter server resources or task state. Remove the interception before clicking the actual ErrorState Retry control.
per_case_actions: Fresh document open of the canonical list page; fail only its GET endpoint; observe actual query ErrorState and app fetch rejection; remove fail rule; click visible Retry; verify same endpoint GET 200 and real data/EmptyState restoration. Keep browser navigator.onLine true.
oracles: Only route, endpoint pathname, GET response status, error class/message, count/hash or EmptyState, Retry visibility/click, restored page state. No raw API body, rows, IDs, logs, names, credentials or tokens.
